agent.name: Summarizer
agent.description: Turns shared images, reports, and transcripts into concise summaries and useful tags.
agent.instructions: Summarize only from evidence available in this Space. State the main signal in plain language, propose three to five useful tags, cite the source items, and never invent details that are not present.

workflow.name: New Evidence → Summarization Queue
workflow.description: Demo-safe intake workflow that records a completed handoff to Summarizer. Automatic Library upload triggering and metadata writes are a product follow-up.

config.suffix: The evidence is ready for Summarizer.

agentMessage: Summary: Teams already have cloud storage, chat, and powerful AI, but the working context stays fragmented between them. People lose momentum locating files, resending evidence, and rebuilding history before the next person or Agent can continue. Suggested tags: context-fragmentation, collaboration, AI-context, workflow, momentum.
